chunks: Mu‘āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār narrated from Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, during his journey, when he descended, he would glorify Allah, and when he ascended, he would magnify Allah.”

key_terms.سَبَّحَ: he glorified Allah, saying words of tasbih

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say when descending or ascending during a journey?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a sunnah (prophetic tradition) of dhikr during travel. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله would say tasbih when descending and takbir when ascending, showing remembrance of Allah in changing states and movements.
